# Kuailu Cloud AI has a bright look in Shenzhen! A new "AI Office Mode" is the hotshot!

- Publication channel: China Daily News Network (central media)
- Release: 2025-10-17
- Original link: [https://caijing.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202510/17/WS68f20b8ea310c4deea5ece75.html](https://caijing.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202510/17/WS68f20b8ea310c4deea5ece75.html]

## Text
On 16 October, the launch of the fourth edition of the “Modical Fukude” product, under the theme “Modern awakening for the sake of new life”, opened in Shenzhen. As an important activity in Fukuda, the launch brought together leading academic experts and representatives of leading artificial and intelligent firms from various sectors to engage in an in-depth dialogue around the full chain breakthrough of AI technology from innovative research and development to the scene site, bringing together the core forces for the construction of the Fukuda region's AI-Quest Biosphere and helping the Shenzhen AI industry to move towards a new phase of “technology landing, value realization”.

Kuailu Technology, a leading producer (CPO) of Kuailu Technology, was invited to participate in the presentation on the theme " New Generation of Corporate Offices ' AI Smarts " , which became a central focus of attention for all of the world ' s attention, thanks to the innovative application of landing to the AB frontier technology.

Kuailu TechnologyCPO Guo Yongping

The launch, in keeping with the core objective of "good use" of AI technology, which combines the three dimensions of scenario supply, ecological synergy and frontier innovation, not only highlights the fruitful results of the full chain of AI technology breakthroughs, but also provides a more comprehensive picture of the practice of the Fukuda region in building open synergies and integrated AI ecology, providing industry with a reference paradigm for technology-situation-ecological development.

At the site of the event, over 10 top AI collective “Sword of Light” companies, innovative forces such as Land Science, Kuailu Technology and the Gaia Silicon Valley Institute of Artificial Intelligence released the latest technological results covering the frontal directions of brain-type models, intelligent bodies, intelligent terminals, etc. Among them, Kuailu Technology, as an artificial intelligence enterprise in the area of focus enterprise office software, brought Kuailu Cloud AI ' s intelligence body to the fore as a direct response to the business office efficiency bottlenecks and the need for precision to fit the diversity of the enterprise, generated wide-ranging attention and discussion.

At present, the enterprise office area faces multiple core challenges: rigid collaborative processes that make it difficult to improve efficiency, cross-application data relying on manual handling to form an “information island”, complex operating thresholds for traditional office software are demanding the professional skills of users and homogenous interfaces and functions do not meet the needs of the enterprise for personalization and landscape. In response to these trade pains, Guo Yongping made it clear that “Kuailu Technology, driven by AID as a core drive, the deep-farming enterprise’s digital intellectual transformation track, based on the Kuailu Cloud AI intelligent body created by the technology of self-study large models, has achieved the full coverage of `AI smart office, AAI smart collaboration, AAI smart conference’, providing a `one-stop, full-process' solution to the business problem.”

He further noted that Kuailu Cloud AI ' s smart body, supported by data access, process optimization and smart decision-making, could help enterprises to achieve "smart, quick and efficient decision-making" and become a central enabler for business to improve management effectiveness, providing firm support to move towards digital business management and truly transform AI technology into an enterprise ' s "productivity".

Kuailu Cloud AI Smart Body

For the future, Kuailu Technology will be a strategic anchor for “AI+”, continuously advancing product overlay and technological refinement, and will be dedicated to exploring the deeper integration of AI technology with the office landscape and making technological innovation more relevant to the real needs of the enterprise. At the end of the speech, Guo Yongping extended a sincere invitation to all of us to work with more companies around the world to promote new technologies and the spread of new scenes, so that innovation can take root and bear fruit in the workplace, and so that the office of wisdom is no longer a PPT concept, but a future within the reach of every enterprise.”
